actions.name: Create a Safe with the ERC-4337 module
actions.summary: The room agrees an owner set and threshold, derives the Safe's counterfactual address, and deploys it with the first UserOperation's initCode, the 4337 module enabled and set as fallback handler. An existing Safe instead enables the module with an evm.safe proposal.

fields.name: owners
fields.means: the owner addresses, one shared by each future owner

fields.name: saltNonce
fields.means: the CREATE2 salt input; with the initializer it fixes the address

fields.name: moduleSetup
fields.means: SafeModuleSetup, delegatecalled by setup() to enable the module

fields.name: module
fields.means: Safe4337Module (v0.3.0: 0x75cf11467937ce3F2f357CE24ffc3DBF8fD5c226), enabled and set as fallback handler

fields.name: nonce
fields.means: the EntryPoint nonce: a 192-bit key (the lane) and a 64-bit sequence; not the Safe's own nonce

fields.name: preVerificationGas
fields.means: gas the bundler charges for calldata and overhead

fields.name: validAfter
fields.means: 48-bit timestamp; the UserOp is invalid before it

fields.name: validUntil
fields.means: 48-bit timestamp; the UserOp is invalid after it (0 means no end)

agreement.threshold: k of n of the new owners sign the first UserOp
agreement.domain: EIP-712 SafeOp over the first UserOp, including keccak256(initCode)

requirements.name: bundler
requirements.target: an ERC-7769 bundler supporting EntryPoint v0.7 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032

requirements.name: gas-prefund
requirements.target: the counterfactual Safe address, or a paymaster

disclosure.field: owner addresses shared by each member
unsigned first UserOp with initCode: owners, threshold (bundler, gas estimation)
owner signatures in the handleOps calldata (who signed)

steps.does: each future owner shares a signing address; the proposer composes owners, threshold and salt; the room computes the counterfactual address from initCode and discloses the account (S1) as pending
k of the new owners re-derive the first UserOp's SafeOp digest, which commits to keccak256(initCode), and sign
steps.signs: the EIP-712 digest keccak256(0x19 || 0x01 || domainSeparator || structHash), where domainSeparator = keccak256(abi.encode(0x47e79534…9218 [EIP712Domain(uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)], chainId, Safe4337Module)) and structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(SAFE_OP_TYPEHASH 0xc03dfc11…ea7f, safe, nonce, keccak256(initCode), keccak256(callData), verificationGasLimit, callGasLimit, preVerificationGas, maxPriorityFeePerGas, maxFeePerGas, keccak256(paymasterAndData), validAfter, validUntil, entryPoint)); one 65-byte secp256k1 ECDSA signature r || s || v per owner

steps.does: a member sends the first UserOp to the bundler; the EntryPoint deploys the proxy through the factory, setup() enables the module via SafeModuleSetup and sets it as fallback handler, then validates the owner signatures against the new Safe
steps.signs: nothing new; the member packs signature = validAfter (6 bytes) || validUntil (6 bytes) || exactly threshold owner signatures in ascending owner order, and sends the UserOp with eth_sendUserOperation

steps.does: reads the Safe's owners, threshold, modules and fallback handler back from the chain and marks the disclosure verified

refusals.what: an initCode the room did not derive from the agreed owners, threshold, salt and addresses
refusals.why: invariant 1: the SafeOp commits to keccak256(initCode); a swapped initCode would deploy a different Safe

refusals.what: a module or EntryPoint address other than the deployment the module's CHANGELOG names for the chosen version
refusals.why: invariant 2: the module is the signature domain's verifyingContract; the wrong one binds signatures elsewhere

refusals.what: a threshold of 0 or above the owner count
refusals.why: Safe setup reverts; muster refuses at propose

refusals.what: a Safe singleton older than v1.4.1
refusals.why: the module README: it MUST only be used with Safe 1.4.1 or newer

claims.claim: The address is fixed by the owners, threshold, salt and deployment addresses before anything is on chain.
The owner set and threshold are public on chain from deployment.
The bundler sees the future Safe's owners when it estimates the first UserOp.
Enabling the module on an existing Safe also replaces its fallback handler (setFallbackHandler).

evidence.what: the setup flow: initCode = proxyFactory || createProxyWithNonce(singleton, setup(... SafeModuleSetup.enableModules([module]) ..., module as fallback handler), saltNonce)

actions.name: Send ETH from a Safe through a bundler
actions.summary: k of n Safe owners approve a UserOperation that sends ETH; one member hands it to a bundler, which puts it on chain through the EntryPoint. The Safe pays the gas.

fields.name: safe
fields.means: the Safe that sends (the UserOp sender)

fields.name: value
fields.means: the amount of ETH, in wei

fields.name: nonce
fields.means: the EntryPoint nonce: a 192-bit key (the lane) and a 64-bit sequence; not the Safe's own nonce

fields.name: preVerificationGas
fields.means: gas the bundler charges for calldata and overhead

fields.name: validAfter
fields.means: 48-bit timestamp; the UserOp is invalid before it

fields.name: validUntil
fields.means: 48-bit timestamp; the UserOp is invalid after it (0 means no end)

agreement.threshold: k of n owners (the Safe's threshold, read from the chain)

requirements.name: bundler
requirements.target: an ERC-7769 bundler endpoint whose eth_supportedEntryPoints includes EntryPoint v0.7 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032

unsigned UserOp: sender, nonce, callData, gas fields (bundler, eth_estimateUserOperationGas)
signed UserOp with owner signatures (bundler, eth_sendUserOperation)
owner signatures in the handleOps calldata (who signed)
the bundler's address and beneficiary; gas paid

steps.does: composes the effect; callData = executeUserOp(to, value, "", 0); reads the EntryPoint nonce for the chosen key and the fee market through the RPC and asks the bundler to estimate gas; the room re-derives the SafeOp digest
each owner re-derives the SafeOp digest from the effect and signs it; the room counts distinct owners up to the threshold
steps.signs: the EIP-712 digest keccak256(0x19 || 0x01 || domainSeparator || structHash), where domainSeparator = keccak256(abi.encode(0x47e79534…9218 [EIP712Domain(uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)], chainId, Safe4337Module)) and structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(SAFE_OP_TYPEHASH 0xc03dfc11…ea7f, safe, nonce, keccak256(initCode), keccak256(callData), verificationGasLimit, callGasLimit, preVerificationGas, maxPriorityFeePerGas, maxFeePerGas, keccak256(paymasterAndData), validAfter, validUntil, entryPoint)); one 65-byte secp256k1 ECDSA signature r || s || v per owner

steps.does: one member packs the signature, sends the UserOp to the bundler; the bundler simulates it (ERC-7562 rules) and calls EntryPoint.handleOps; the EntryPoint calls the Safe's validateUserOp, which the fallback handler forwards to the module; the module checks the owner signatures with Safe.checkSignatures, pays the prefund and then runs executeUserOp → execTransactionFromModule
steps.signs: nothing new; the member packs signature = validAfter (6 bytes) || validUntil (6 bytes) || exactly threshold owner signatures in ascending owner order, and sends the UserOp with eth_sendUserOperation

steps.does: reads eth_getUserOperationReceipt from the bundler, or the UserOperationEvent through the RPC; final when the chain is

refusals.what: an owner approval over a SafeOp digest that is not the one the room re-derives from the effect
refusals.why: invariant 1 (F-4): effects are reviewed, materializations are signed, and a mismatch is refused

refusals.what: a SafeOp whose domain chainId, verifyingContract (the module) or entryPoint field differs from the disclosed account's environment
refusals.why: invariant 2 (F-5): the signature must be worthless on any other chain, module or EntryPoint

refusals.what: a stale EntryPoint nonce: the (key, sequence) pair was consumed on chain since the proposal, re-read at review and at settle
refusals.why: invariant 10: the nonce is an external read that reached the signed bytes; the EntryPoint would reject it anyway

refusals.what: a validUntil later than the room envelope's expiry, or 0 (no end) when the envelope has one
refusals.why: invariant 2: every signing payload commits to expiry; the chain-level window must not outlive the envelope

refusals.what: callData whose selector is not executeUserOp or executeUserOpWithErrorString
refusals.why: the module reverts UnsupportedExecutionFunction; the card could not say what executes

refusals.what: a gas price, nonce or other input that reached the SafeOp without a recorded read
refusals.why: invariant 10: nothing is signed whose inputs cannot be accounted for

refusals.what: assembling more signatures than the threshold, or owners out of ascending order
refusals.why: the module's _checkSignaturesLength rejects extra bytes and Safe.checkNSignatures requires ascending owners (GS026)

claims.claim: Owners sign every UserOp field except the signature, including gas limits, fees, initCode and paymasterAndData, so a bundler cannot change them.
A signature is valid only on one chain, for one Safe, through one module and one EntryPoint.
A signed SafeOp stops being valid after validUntil, when one is set; the EntryPoint enforces it.
Approving costs owners nothing; the Safe pays the EntryPoint prefund and the bundler is reimbursed from it.
The bundler can delay or refuse to include the UserOp.
The bundler sees the signed UserOp, including which owners signed, before the chain does.
The Safe's other modules, and k owners through execTransaction, can still act outside this path.
claims.party: every other enabled Safe module; any k owners using execTransaction

claims.claim: The EntryPoint nonce is a second replay domain: a 4337 proposal and an execTransaction proposal do not conflict by nonce, only by state.

steps.signs: nothing new; the member packs signature = validAfter (6 bytes) || validUntil (6 bytes) || exactly threshold owner signatures in ascending owner order, and sends the UserOp with eth_sendUserOperation

refusals.what: an owner approval over a SafeOp digest that is not the one the room re-derives from the effect
refusals.why: invariant 1 (F-4): effects are reviewed, materializations are signed, and a mismatch is refused

refusals.what: a SafeOp whose domain chainId, verifyingContract (the module) or entryPoint field differs from the disclosed account's environment
refusals.why: invariant 2 (F-5): the signature must be worthless on any other chain, module or EntryPoint

refusals.what: a stale EntryPoint nonce: the (key, sequence) pair was consumed on chain since the proposal, re-read at review and at settle
refusals.why: invariant 10: the nonce is an external read that reached the signed bytes; the EntryPoint would reject it anyway

refusals.what: a validUntil later than the room envelope's expiry, or 0 (no end) when the envelope has one
refusals.why: invariant 2: every signing payload commits to expiry; the chain-level window must not outlive the envelope

refusals.what: callData whose selector is not executeUserOp or executeUserOpWithErrorString
refusals.why: the module reverts UnsupportedExecutionFunction; the card could not say what executes

refusals.what: a gas price, nonce or other input that reached the SafeOp without a recorded read
refusals.why: invariant 10: nothing is signed whose inputs cannot be accounted for

refusals.what: assembling more signatures than the threshold, or owners out of ascending order
refusals.why: the module's _checkSignaturesLength rejects extra bytes and Safe.checkNSignatures requires ascending owners (GS026)

refusals.what: a change that leaves the threshold above the owner count, or a prevOwner that is not the owner's predecessor
refusals.why: OwnerManager reverts; the owner list is an external read re-read at settle (invariant 10)

claims.claim: Owners sign every UserOp field except the signature, including gas limits, fees, initCode and paymasterAndData, so a bundler cannot change them.
A signature is valid only on one chain, for one Safe, through one module and one EntryPoint.
A signed SafeOp stops being valid after validUntil, when one is set; the EntryPoint enforces it.
Approving costs owners nothing; the Safe pays the EntryPoint prefund and the bundler is reimbursed from it.
The bundler can delay or refuse to include the UserOp.
The bundler sees the signed UserOp, including which owners signed, before the chain does.
The Safe's other modules, and k owners through execTransaction, can still act outside this path.
claims.party: every other enabled Safe module; any k owners using execTransaction

claims.claim: The EntryPoint nonce is a second replay domain: a 4337 proposal and an execTransaction proposal do not conflict by nonce, only by state.
The Safe's address stays the same; the change is one proposal.
Signatures for other pending UserOps are checked against the owners at execution time, so a removed owner's signature stops counting.
The new owner set is public on chain once settled.
